text:
The plate is a square side plate, probably about 22 cm across. On it are chopped fried or scrambled egg (possibly 2 eggs) and 5 round pieces of chorizo or sausage slices.

The egg portion looks like about 2 eggs, roughly 100 g, at about 150 kcal. The sausage pieces are each about 3 cm across and maybe 15 g each, so about 75 g in total. At roughly 4 kcal/g for chorizo, that comes to about 300 kcal, but they may be thinner than that, so I'll estimate about 250 kcal.

Total is about 175 g of food and about 400 kcal.
